# Excalidraw Laser Pointer

This layer contains the source code for a laser pointer application, including classes and functions for managing laser pointer settings and calculations.

## Overview

This layer focuses on the implementation of a laser pointer feature within the Excalidraw application.

## Responsibilities

- Manages laser pointer settings and options.
- Performs mathematical calculations for laser pointer functionality.

## Key components

| File | Purpose | Main definitions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`packages/laser-pointer/src/index.ts`](../../packages/laser-pointer/src/index.ts) | Exports the Point class and uses state and math. | `Point` |
| [`packages/laser-pointer/src/math.ts`](../../packages/laser-pointer/src/math.ts) | Exports Point, mathematical functions, and types. | `Point`, `add`, `sub`, `smul`, `norm`, `rot` |
| [`packages/laser-pointer/src/simplify.ts`](../../packages/laser-pointer/src/simplify.ts) | Exports Douglas-Peucker simplification function. | `douglasPeucker` |
| [`packages/laser-pointer/src/state.ts`](../../packages/laser-pointer/src/state.ts) | Exports size mapping details and laser pointer options. | `SizeMappingDetails`, `LaserPointerOptions`, `LaserPointer` |

## How it works

- **index.ts**: Exports the `Point` class and uses state and math functions.
- **math.ts**: Exports `Point`, mathematical functions, and types.
- **simplify.ts**: Exports the Douglas-Peucker simplification function.
- **state.ts**: Exports size mapping details and laser pointer options.

- Configuration files: `packages/laser-pointer/tsconfig.json`.
